message.content:
In May, Hailey's bakery celebrated a special sale event as part of their anniversary from April 15 to April 17. During this time, Hailey offered various discounts and introduced new bread products to their customers. She expressed excitement at the opportunity to showcase these special items and even invited Li Hua, who was a regular customer, to come by the bakery and enjoy the celebration. Specifically, Hailey prepared some special treats for the occasion to ensure that Li Hua would have a delightful experience. Though the exact details of the offerings are not listed, it's clear that there was a focus on new and exciting bread-related specialties for customers to try during the anniversary celebration.

In May, Hailey's bakery also expanded its offerings to include gluten-free bread options, which were planned to be ready for delivery starting from the following week. This new line of products addressed the needs of customers seeking gluten-free alternatives and also included the possibility of integrating these options into regular delivery orders.

Furthermore, Hailey's bakery, under the employee Alice, continued its doorstep delivery service which had become an additional convenience for customers. Alice, along with another new clerk, provided deliveries at specified times, which was a part of the bakery's growing delivery service responsibilities.

To summarize, during May, Hailey's bakery offered special anniversary discounts and new bread products, introduced gluten-free options for delivery, and maintained its doorstep delivery service with a new team member Alice joining the delivery brigade alongside Hailey's regular services.
